jobs.title: Director, Software and Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Emeryville, CA, Profluent is backed by leading investors including Altimeter Capital, Bezos Expeditions, Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, AIX Ventures, and Convergent Ventures and has raised over $150M to date.

We're looking for a Director of Software and Data Engineering to lead Profluent's software engineering function and build the platform connecting AI-driven protein design, high-throughput experimental screening, and quantitative data analysis.

You'll own the software and data architecture connecting computational designs to the constructs, samples, assays, and measurements generated through automated laboratory workflows. Your team will build the scientist-facing tools, integrations, and data systems needed to manage experimental data at scale, preserve lineage and context, and turn results into reliable inputs for analysis, machine learning, and the next round of design.

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical foundation, sound judgment, and a track record of building scalable data platforms. You'll manage and mentor a small team while remaining close to architecture, data modeling, and technical decision-making, partnering across science, automation, data, and ML to advance Profluent's lab-in-the-loop platform.

Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow Profluent's software engineering team, with responsibility for technical direction, hiring, organizational development, and execution
Own the roadmap for software and data engineering, balancing scientific impact, user needs, delivery speed, scalability, and long-term platform strategy
Define the software and data architecture, system boundaries, and data flows connecting computational design, high-throughput experimentation, analysis, and machine learning
Architect and guide delivery of scientist-facing applications and data systems supporting experimental design, sample tracking, laboratory automation, assay data capture, and analysis
Establish scalable data models and standards for identifiers, provenance, lineage, versioning, interoperability, and access control, ensuring experimental results are reliable, reusable, and model-ready
Partner across science, automation, bioinformatics, data science, and ML while establishing strong engineering and product practices that drive reliable delivery and adoption

Qualifications

8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing or leading engineers
BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Bioengineering, Computational Biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Track record of leading teams that architect and deliver production-quality, data-intensive software platforms
Strong technical foundation in Python, backend systems, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and modern software development practices
Experience designing data architectures, schemas, and domain models for complex scientific, experimental, or similarly interconnected workflows
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous user and scientific needs into reliable systems, make sound technical and product tradeoffs, and drive adoption

Preferences

Experience building scientific data infrastructure, research software, LIMS integrations, or scientist-facing applications
Experience with Benchling, laboratory automation, instrument integration, sample tracking, or high-throughput experimental platforms
Experience connecting experimental workflows with downstream analysis and machine learning
Familiarity with biological data from protein engineering, gene editing, sequencing, screening, or mammalian or bacterial systems
Frontend development experience and an interest in building intuitive scientist-facing interfaces

What We Offer

High-growth opportunity with meaningful impact on the future of protein design
Competitive compensation package with equity participation
401(k) with a strong employer match
Comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance
Generous PTO policy and commitment to work-life balance
Professional development opportunities in a cutting-edge field at the intersection of AI and biology

Profluent Bio, Inc is an equal opportunity employer promoting diversity and inclusion in the workspace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical conditions, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), sex (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and breastfeeding), genetic information, taking or requesting statutorily protected leave, or any other basis protected by law.

Work Authorization Requirement

Applicants must have ongoing work authorization in the United States that does not require employer sponsorship. Sponsorship will not be provided now or at any time in the future for this position.

Employment Eligibility Verification

Legal authorization to work in the United States is required. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired must verify their identity and work eligibility and complete the required employment verification form upon hire.

Hiring Salary Range

$268,000-$355,000 USD

Any resume submitted without a signed agreement and an active search request from our Talent team will be treated as the property of Profluent, and no placement fee will be owed.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Engineering Opportunity: Director of Engineering

iENG Design
is seeking a qualified professional to join our Engineering
team. iENG's method of engineering is unique: We begin with the end in mind, and we challenge everything. We take time to understand the project we want to deliver. We understand the owner's views, use of building, the owner's operation and maintenance capabilities. We look at first cost v. operation cost v. life cycle cost. Every iENG project has a best value and best design---and that's what we deliver. An IMI Company, iENG serves nationwide Fortune 500 clients across the Institutional, Commercial and Industrial markets---there isn't a project our team cannot tackle.

iENG Design is headquartered in Chesterfield, MO and has branch offices in Granite City, IL, Nashville, TN and Charlotte, NC. Services & Capabilities include: Engineering & Design, VDC/BIM Coordination, Construction Support, Scheduling, Commissioning, Retro Commissioning and Inspection Services. iENG currently ranks as one of the largest
engineering/design firms by revenue in the region.

We are currently looking for a Director of Engineering
to join our Engineering
team
located at our office in Atlanta, GA.
Our ideal candidate for a Director of Engineering
is someone who has 10+ years of mechanical or civil experience
with 3-5 years in a leadership role. The Director of Engineering
provides comprehensive leadership for all engineering personnel within the office, driving technical excellence while ensuring alignment with corporate standards and client expectations. This role manages an office or department's overall engineering operations, staffing, and financial performance. As the senior engineering leader for the office, the Director sets local operational policy and process improvements, oversees multiple Engineering Team Leads/Managers, and partners with business development on pursuits and client strategy. This role carries office-level P&L or department budget responsibility.

Primary responsibilities for iENG’s Director of Engineering include:

Manage all engineering personnel for the office location, including Engineering Team Leads and engineers at every level
Oversee hiring, performance reviews, and professional development initiatives
Provide mentoring, coaching, and career guidance • Lead training programs and technical development opportunities
Address performance issues and implement improvement plans
Developing, maintaining, and improving QC standards, checklists, workflows, and SOPs; ensure review schedules align with project timelines.
Manage office-level P&L or department budget
Monitor project budgets and engineering hours across the office portfolio
Ensure compliance with engineering standards and code requirements
Set local operational policy and drive process improvements
Provide technical oversight on complex engineering projects
Participate in design turnover, VDC turnover, and build strategy meetings
Partner with business development on pursuits and client strategy
Advocate for proper engineering and VDC support from project management teams
Collaborate with Engineering Team Leads on workforce planning and resource allocation
Coordinate with other offices and business units on project staffing needs
Conduct weekly debriefs with the VP/Senior VP, Office/Region
Encourage team site visits and participate in site walks with junior team members
Office P&L Ownership - Full operational accountability for the office/department's engineering function
Technical Oversight - Providing technical oversight on the office's most complex engineering projects
Staffing and Capacity Planning - Managing all engineering personnel, hiring, and workforce planning for the office
Business Development Partnership - Partnering on pursuits, proposals, and client strategy
Standards and Quality Oversight - Ensuring compliance with engineering standards and code requirements
Future: Regional Coordination - Coordinating staffing and initiatives with other offices/business units

Primary qualifications for iENG’s Director of Engineeringinclude:

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Civil Engineering or related field. (B.S. required)
Master’s degree or MBA preferred
Professional Engineer (PE) licensure in one or more states strongly preferred.
10+ years of mechanical engineering experience with at least 3- 5 years in a leadership role.
Multi-office collaboration experience preferred.
Expert knowledge of mechanical engineering fundamentals
Advanced HVAC system design expertise, including VAV systems, chilled water plants, boilers, heat pumps, energy recovery, and building automation
Experience with engineering calculation software
Comprehensive understanding of mechanical codes and standards; knowledge of ASHRAE standards and NFPA codes; understanding of local building codes and permitting processes
Value engineering capabilities for cost management and constructability review
Proven office or department P&L or budget management experience
Business development experience is preferred; design/build leadership experience is preferred
Demonstrated staffing and workforce planning experience

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Salary Range: $150,000 - $175,000
Employee Stock Ownership Program
Discretionary Annual Bonus'
Health Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
401k with Discretionary Company Contributions
Paid Time Off (Vacation; Sick Time)
Paid Company Holidays
Paid Parental Leave
Tuition Reimbursement Program
Employee Assistance Program
Gym Reimbursements

DIVERSITY:

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion starts with us. The IMI companies strive to build a team that is truly reflective of the communities we serve in every level of our business. We know that when diverse minds and perspectives come together, the possibilities are limitless.

WHY iENG DESIGN?

The iENG team is led by innovative engineers with vast experience across multiple industries. Their passion and understanding of the design & construction process results in a higher level of excellence within our entire engineering & design group. IMI companies know that to tackle the challenging projects we are faced with every day takes a team of creative problem solvers who aren’t afraid to be bold. Which is why IMI companies work every day to create a work environment that gives back to our employees.

Our philosophy is to hire talented people, provide them with the training, tools, and resources to be successful, empower them to go and contribute to the success of the company, and to reward performance. If you’re ready to be a part of our team AND a part of our solution, APPLY TODAY!

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
VERRA MOBILITY

SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

Director, Software Engineering

Who we are...

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 4,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

Culture

Verra Mobility Corporation is a dynamic, entrepreneurial company that operates with a people-first philosophy and approach. The company lives by its core values—Do What's Right, Choose Courage Over Comfort, Win Together, and Own It—in everything it does for its customers and team members. The company seeks to grow, both organically and through acquisition, to continue to be the undisputed market leader with a bias for action, customer focus, teamwork, drive for results, and commitment to excellence.

Position Overview

The Director, Software Engineering is the technical subject matter expert and engineering leader for the Platform portfolio, reporting to the SVP, Software Engineering and owning technology strategy and end to end delivery outcomes for the portfolio's squads. This role requires deep domain expertise in the portfolio's problem space, current fluency across modern engineering practices, and the operating pace expected of a modern software organization.

You will partner with the external Product Portfolio Director on product vision, engage directly with partner and customer technical teams on architecture and integration, and be responsible for evaluating and developing the technical leadership within your portfolio. Your work will determine how quickly a steady state organization can move, and whether the portfolio's platforms are built once and reused, or rebuilt every time a new need arises.

Essential Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Architecture

Own Portfolio Technology Strategy:
Define technology strategy and end to end delivery outcomes for the portfolio's squads, maintaining deep domain expertise in the portfolio's problem space and current fluency in the broader technology and competitive landscape, including modern AI and machine learning solution categories.
Identify Reuse Before Rebuild:
Identify where shared platform capabilities can be extended or reused rather than rebuilt, partnering with the Platform team and Senior Enterprise Architect to avoid duplicated effort.
Maintain Domain and Integration Fluency:
Maintain a working view of service boundaries, API contracts, and event driven or asynchronous processing patterns across the portfolio, recognizing a fragile integration or a duplicative build before it hardens into a dependency other teams must unwind.

Delivery, Migration & Operational Ownership

Own End to End Delivery:
Own predictable, high quality delivery across the portfolio's squads, including roadmap commitments, release readiness, budget adherence, and operational stability.
Raise Delivery Pace:
Change how quickly a steady state organization moves, accelerating delivery pace and urgency within an existing, already staffed organization.
Lead Platform Migrations:
Lead live system migrations and legacy platform transitions, including cutover sequencing, data reconciliation, and rollback planning, as clients and workloads move off legacy platforms and onto current ones.
Govern Data & Security:
Apply data architecture and governance principles, including data lineage and stewardship for shared or regulated datasets, and ensure the portfolio's systems meet security and compliance expectations for multi tenant, transaction heavy systems operating across multiple jurisdictions.
Own Bid & Contract Review:
Own final review and approval of new contracts and bids for the Platform portfolio, building on the Manager's initial technical and compliance review to confirm proposed work is achievable within existing governance, architectural, and delivery constraints before commitments are made.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

Develop Technical Leaders:
Personally assess whether direct and indirect reports are functioning above or below the title held, and act on that assessment through coaching, role redefinition, or personnel change.
Ensure Technical Succession:
Treat technical succession as a stated priority, so no portfolio depends on a single person's tenure for its technical continuity.
Partner Across the Enterprise:
Partner closely with the Portfolio Architect as the technical decision making pair for the portfolio, coordinate with peer Directors and the Senior Enterprise Architect to keep cross portfolio integrations coherent, and align regularly with the Product Portfolio Director function to reconcile product vision and technical reality.

We're looking for a technical leader with a proven track record of owning outcomes, modernizing platforms, and raising delivery pace at scale. The ideal candidate will bring the following capabilities:

Portfolio Technology Strategy

Ability to define and sustain a coherent technology strategy across a multi squad portfolio, balancing standardization with legitimate portfolio specific divergence.

Architecture & Integration Judgment

Fluency in domain boundaries, API contract design, and event driven or asynchronous processing patterns, sufficient to judge whether a proposed integration is a durable seam or a future liability.

Migration & Modernization Leadership

Demonstrated experience leading a live system migration or legacy platform transition, including cutover sequencing, data reconciliation, and rollback planning.

Data & Governance Fluency

Working knowledge of data architecture, data lineage, and the security and compliance considerations relevant to multi tenant, transaction heavy systems.

Talent Development & Succession

Track record of assessing, coaching, and developing technical leaders, including making difficult talent calls when needed.

Executive & Partner Communication

Technical credibility sufficient to lead architecture and technology discussions directly with partner and customer engineering teams, and to evaluate a vendor pitch or build proposal critically.

Bid & Contract Ownership

Ability to review and approve contracts and bids for technical, architectural, and delivery feasibility, ensuring commitments are not made against a portfolio that cannot support them.

Qualifications

Experience:
10+ years in software engineering delivering enterprise systems, including 5+ years leading multiple teams or squads through Managers and Tech Leads. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience required.
Technical Fluency:
Current fluency with modern engineering stacks relevant to the portfolio, including .NET/C#, Java, SQL, modern web frameworks, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and event driven or asynchronous processing patterns such as message queues and event streaming.
Migration & Legacy Transition:
Demonstrated experience leading a live system migration or legacy platform transition, including cutover sequencing, data reconciliation, and rollback planning.
Data & Compliance:
Working knowledge of data architecture and governance principles, including data lineage and stewardship, and fluency in security and compliance considerations for multi tenant, transaction heavy systems operating across multiple jurisdictions.
AI & Emerging Technology:
Working knowledge of current AI and machine learning solution categories and their practical application in transaction heavy, government adjacent, or mobility industries, sufficient to evaluate a vendor pitch or build proposal critically and weigh build versus buy trade offs.
Talent Leadership:
Demonstrated willingness and ability to make difficult talent calls, including role realignment or replacement, along with strong judgment on when to standardize across the enterprise versus allow portfolio specific divergence.
Contract & Bid Review:
Ability to evaluate contracts and bids for technical, architectural, and compliance feasibility, owning final review and approval ahead of executive sign off.
Domain Expertise (Preferred):
Experience in mobility, tolling, parking, or other transaction heavy, government adjacent industries is preferred, along with leading an organization through transformation from steady state maintenance to active platform investment.
Vendor & Partner Evaluation (Preferred):
Experience evaluating or negotiating build versus buy decisions for major platform capabilities, including vendor and partner architecture reviews, and experience partnering with an external product organization on a shared roadmap, is also a plus.

Verra Mobility Values

An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

Own It:
We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
Do What's Right:
We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
Choose Courage Over Comfort:
We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
Win Together:
We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.

Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Director of Software Development is responsible for defining, executing, and managing the full software lifecycle for internally developed medical device software. This includes collaborating with stakeholders to capture and prioritize requirements, leading development teams to design and implement solutions, and ensuring projects meet business, regulatory, and quality objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Define and update the software development strategy to streamline current workflows and enable future product growth.
Oversee projects from planning through release, including scoping, prioritization, risk management, and resource allocation.
Ensure delivery of projects within established timelines, budgets, and quality criteria, while demonstrating measurable business value.
Lead, motivate, and manage a diverse team of senior and junior software engineers, fostering collaboration and alignment with corporate goals.
Participate in hiring, performance evaluations, team development, conflict resolution, and corrective actions as needed.
Develop and manage operating and capital budgets, ensuring fiscal discipline.
Drive adherence to the company’s Code of Ethical Conduct, Quality System, ISO standards, and FDA regulations.
Collaborate with R&D leadership on the development and launch of next-generation technologies and services.
Guide outsourcing decisions to create efficiencies, reduce costs, and safeguard intellectual property.
Champion the company’s culture with a focus on empowerment, accountability, creativity, and execution.
Serve as a credible representative with physicians, consultants, suppliers, and internal partners.

Essential Functions

Ensure all development activities comply with FDA GMP/QSR and ISO13485 requirements.
Support a culture of continuous improvement aligned with the company’s Quality Policy and regulatory standards.
Recommend and implement improvements to enhance the customer experience.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field (minimum requirement).
15 years of experience in the medical device industry, including at least 5 years in a team leadership role.

Skills And Competencies

Proven leadership with the ability to develop strategy, drive execution, and deliver results.
Expertise in agile development methodologies and software lifecycle management.
Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and relationship-building skills.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication.
Ability to manage multiple complex projects and work cross-functionally across Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Marketing, and Business Development.
Creativity, adaptability, and a proactive, professional approach in a fast-paced environment.

Who we are
: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. Our vision is both simple and ambitious: to put our drinks on every table. 
We are the leading global independent beverage solutions provider. We serve a broad range of national and international retailers as well as Global, National and Emerging (GNE) brands. Our products are distributed worldwide from our production sites in Europe, North America, and Australia.  Although our own branding may not appear on the labels of the beverages we produce, there is a good chance you are reading this while sipping one of our drinks. 
Our ambition is to continually improve and it’s what keeps us at the top of our game.  We are solutions-based.  We are innovative.  We seek out new challenges and conquer them.  This is our company ethos, but it’s our people’s too: Refresco is at the cutting edge of a fast-moving industry because we have passionate people pushing the boundaries of what’s best. 
Stop and think: how would  YOU
 put our drinks on every table? 
Summary Description:

Reporting to the Vice President of Engineering and Project Management, the Director of Engineering drives improvements within the operations maintenance organization across 5+ facilities in the assigned region of Refresco NA. This role is responsible for advancing production technologies by applying sound maintenance and reliability principles. This role also ensures the effective execution of capital projects, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement initiatives to drive operational excellence. The Director of Engineering directly manages a team of Project Engineering Managers, each responsible for overseeing engineering efforts across multiple facilities within their assigned regions.

Essential Functions:

Develop a support organization capable of managing plant maintenance operations regionally in US and Canada.
Deliver criteria to determine whether the Maintenance Organization is fulfilling the needs of each Plant.
Develop and manage engineering and maintenance budgets across all locations, ensuring effective resource allocation for seasonal rebuilds, equipment needs, and capital projects. Monitor expenses to optimize costs and maintain alignment with company financial objectives.
Oversee the planning, execution, and prioritization of plant-driven capital projects to ensure alignment with company standards, cost-effectiveness, and business needs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement new initiatives that enhance capacity, flexibility, cost efficiency, and quality across facilities.
Provide strategic oversight on staffing, performance management, and workforce planning to meet business objectives.
Lead the implementation of SAP Maintenance throughout the system.
Other duties as assigned, including special projects that may require significant travel to manufacturing plant locations.
Work as an integral member of the engineering, maintenance and Infrastructure design and installation teams to ensure the timely design, infrastructure and installation and insuring delivery is on-time and within project budgets. 
Creates and maintains planning and execution models for site/line startups by working with Process Improvement and Learning communities to clarify and Refresco Supply Chain Procedures to ensure best practice and standard work is appropriately valued and leveraged to support rapid Supply Expansion.
Assess project requirements and workload.  Allocate resources within the Engineering teams at each location
Provide guidance to plant assigned engineers by defining scope of work, critical milestones and expected project completion dates.
Establish strong cross-functional collaboration by communicating project plans, milestones, and results to stakeholders at all levels.
Engage with plant leadership to align resources and adapt processes to meet evolving business needs.
Establish and maintain adequate departmental staffing and manage consultant services to make possible the construction of equipment and facilities that conform to approved specifications and regulatory requirements.
Clearly define and align department goals, communicate the goals to the team and hold yourself and your team accountable for achieving the goals
Coordinates maintenance aspects of new product launches and new or modified operational processes.
Leads and directs the work of other employees and has responsibility for personnel actions including hiring, performance management, and termination.  
Supervision is often provided through a team of subordinate managers.  
Coaches and develops staff to enhance functional and leadership skills and expertise 
Accountable for planning and evaluating performance, staff training and development, recruitment and may contribute to pay recommendations, subject to policies. 

Required Skills:

Foster a culture of continuous improvement through mentoring, coaching, and leadership development.
Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's principles, policies and applicable laws.
Foster an environment in which responsibilities and results are achieved with the highest level of commitment to quality.
Follows all policies, procedures, ergonomic standards and safety requirements directed by Refresco and the department
Knowledgeable of infrastructure systems (nitrogen, electrical, steam, compressed air).
Comply with applicable regulatory requirements including OSHA, SQF
Knowledgeable of emergency planning and response team operations
Excellent Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, MS Project skills, AutoCAD

Competencies:

Leadership: Foster a culture of empowerment by building relationships based on trust, lead courageously on a day-to-day basis, and inspire growth with a clear and ambitious vision that guides the collective effort toward success.
Communication & Collaboration: Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to engage multiple stakeholder groups, including suppliers and customers.
Project & Time Management: Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects, and meet business objectives efficiently.
Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong critical thinking and analytical abilities to assess challenges, develop solutions, and drive continuous improvement.
Leadership & Decision-Making: Ability to see the bigger picture, make data-driven decisions, and systematically solve complex problems.
Safety & Best Practices: Commitment to upholding safety standards, implementing manufacturing best practices, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Adaptability & Resilience: Positive attitude with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while managing competing priorities.

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field); advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of engineering leadership experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in the beverage or food industry.
Proven experience managing multi-site engineering teams and large-scale capital projects.
Strong understanding of TPM, Lean Manufacturing, and Six Sigma methodologies.
Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.description:
Engineering Director

Location: San Antonio, TX
Work Arrangement: Onsite
Salary: $115,000–$125,000 per year
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM–4:00 PM
Hours: 40 hours per week
Weekend Work: Occasional Saturday/Sunday work may be required based on customer availability
Direct Reports: 8

ABOUT US:

We are a well-established industrial automation and engineering company specializing in the design and delivery of custom automation solutions for a wide range of manufacturing and industrial applications
Our multidisciplinary engineering organization brings together expertise across mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, controls, robotics, and automation. We develop technically sound, manufacturable, safe, and commercially viable solutions tailored to each customer's unique production requirements
From concept development and engineering through fabrication, assembly, commissioning, and customer delivery, our teams work collaboratively throughout the full project lifecycle. This provides engineering leaders with the opportunity to make a direct impact on technical execution, operational performance, team development, and customer success

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Engineering Director
will lead and manage the Engineering Department, providing strategic and technical leadership across mechanical, electrical, controls, robotics, and other engineering disciplines
This role is responsible for ensuring the engineering organization consistently delivers technically sound, manufacturable, safe, and profitable automation solutions
that meet customer requirements, project schedules, budgets, and company standards
The Engineering Director will currently oversee a team of 8 direct reports
and will be responsible for developing the people, processes, standards, technical discipline, and accountability required for successful project execution
The Director is not expected to personally solve every engineering problem. Instead, the role is responsible for ensuring engineering issues are identified, assigned, managed, escalated when necessary, and ultimately resolved

DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES:

Provide overall leadership and direction across mechanical, electrical, controls, robotics, and other engineering disciplines

Lead, manage, and develop a team of approximately 8 engineering professionals

Establish departmental priorities, allocate resources, resolve conflicts, and maintain accountability across the engineering organization
Ensure engineering milestones are established, monitored, and achieved
Monitor engineering hours, schedules, technical risks, procurement dependencies, and project deliverables
Identify projects at risk of falling behind schedule and initiate corrective action before issues impact fabrication, assembly, commissioning, or customer delivery
Maintain responsibility for the technical integrity of engineering designs
released by the department
Ensure appropriate design reviews are completed for critical systems
Ensure engineering solutions meet customer specifications, applicable standards, safety requirements, and internal engineering practices
Develop and enforce standardized design practices, drawing standards, component selection, programming standards, documentation requirements, BOM practices, revision control, and reusable engineering libraries

Ensure engineering works closely with machining, fabrication, assembly, electrical, and commissioning teams
Promote Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA)
principles, including manufacturability, assembly efficiency, accessibility, serviceability, cost, and lead time
Maintain visibility of engineering workload across active and upcoming projects
Allocate engineering personnel based on capability, workload, project priority, and technical requirements
Identify staffing, subcontracting, and scheduling constraints before they become project risks
Monitor actual engineering hours against quoted and budgeted hours
Investigate engineering budget overruns, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions
Ensure engineering decisions balance technical performance with commercial responsibility

Develop engineers through coaching, technical mentoring, training, performance reviews, and increasing levels of responsibility
Identify skill gaps and establish employee development plans
Build organizational depth and reduce dependency on individual employees for critical technical knowledge
Establish clear expectations around communication, ownership, schedule performance, documentation, attention to detail, and completion of assigned responsibilities
Address recurring performance issues promptly and appropriately
Maintain strong communication between Engineering, Project Management, Sales, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Assembly, and Service

Ensure engineering proactively communicates technical changes, project risks, delays, and decisions that may affect other departments
Participate in customer technical discussions when appropriate, including concept development, design reviews, specification clarification, FAT preparation, and significant technical issue resolution

Ensure customer changes, scope changes, and internal design changes are properly documented and communicated before significant engineering or manufacturing work proceeds
Support Project Management in identifying changes that may require additional cost or schedule adjustments
Conduct post-project engineering reviews to identify recurring problems, lessons learned, design improvements, standardization opportunities, and opportunities to reduce engineering hours
Identify technical and execution risks early and escalate significant schedule, cost, safety, or performance concerns
to executive management
Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, engineering tools, and automation technologies
Identify and implement technologies and processes that improve engineering efficiency, strengthen technical capabilities, and maintain competitiveness within the automation industry
Perform other engineering leadership responsibilities as assigned

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:

The successful candidate should have a strong combination of hands-on engineering design experience and engineering management experience

Required qualifications include:

Proven experience leading and managing engineering teams
Strong hands-on background in engineering design
, preferably within industrial automation, custom machinery, manufacturing equipment, or a similar environment
Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering functions
Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, controls, robotics, and automation engineering disciplines

Proven experience managing engineering resources, schedules, budgets, and project priorities
Strong understanding of design for manufacturing and assembly (DFMA)

Experience establishing and enforcing engineering standards, processes, and documentation practices
Strong technical problem-solving and decision-making skills
Experience managing engineering projects through the full project lifecycle
Experience identifying and managing technical, schedule, cost, and execution risks
Strong customer-facing and technical communication skills
Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop engineering professionals
Strong organizational, communication, leadership, and project-management skills
Ability to balance technical quality, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and business objectives

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

The following qualifications are preferred and align with the previously discussed requirements:
Significant experience in industrial automation and custom equipment design

Strong background in mechanical design and engineering

Experience with robotics and hard automation

Experience with hydraulic and pneumatic systems and related controls

Familiarity with controls automation components and systems

Experience establishing engineering design standards and reusable engineering practices
Experience with engineering documentation, BOMs, revision control, and design-release processes
Experience working closely with machining, fabrication, assembly, electrical, commissioning, purchasing, and service teams

Experience participating in customer design reviews, technical discussions, FAT preparation, and installation or commissioning activities
Experience driving engineering process improvements and standardization
Ability to identify emerging technologies and determine their practical application within an automation environment

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

There is flexibility around the exact number of years of experience. The priority is finding someone with the right combination of technical design expertise and engineering leadership experience

The ideal candidate will have:

Significant hands-on engineering design experience

Proven engineering management or leadership experience

Experience leading engineers while maintaining a strong understanding of the technical work being performed
A background that demonstrates progression from technical engineering/design responsibilities into leadership and management

Candidates who have only managed engineering teams without meaningful hands-on design experience may not be as well suited for the role. Likewise, highly experienced designers without demonstrated leadership and people-management experience may not fully meet the needs of the position.

The strongest candidates will be able to understand the technical details, lead the engineering team, manage project execution, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

KEY LEADERSHIP AREAS:

Engineering Leadership:
Lead and develop a multidisciplinary engineering organization while establishing clear priorities, accountability, technical standards, and performance expectations
Project Execution:
Ensure engineering resources, milestones, budgets, technical requirements, and deliverables remain aligned throughout the project lifecycle
Technical Excellence:
Maintain high standards for engineering quality, safety, manufacturability, documentation, and technical integrity
People & Organizational Development:
Develop engineering talent, strengthen technical capabilities, establish succession depth, and create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement
Business & Commercial Accountability:
Ensure engineering decisions support project profitability while balancing technical requirements, customer expectations, schedule, quality, and cost

COMPENSATION & WORK ENVIRONMENT

Salary
: $115,000–$125,000 per year

This is an onsite Engineering Director position in Schertz, Texas
, with responsibility for leading an engineering team of approximately 8 direct reports
.

The standard work schedule is:
Monday–Friday

7:30 AM–4:00 PM

Approximately 40 hours per week

Occasional Saturday or Sunday work may be required
based on customer availability and project requirements.

READY TO LEAD WHAT'S NEXT?

If you're an experienced engineering leader who combines hands-on design expertise with proven management experience
, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact
Bring your engineering design background, automation expertise, leadership experience, and project execution skills
to an organization delivering customized industrial solutions from concept through manufacturing, assembly, commissioning, and customer delivery
If you're ready to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team while driving technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are an organization that values diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including minorities and persons with disabilities.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Consilio is seeking for a hands-on Director of Software Development to lead the engineering team to work on our some of our market leading AI-enabled legal automation platforms that governs the end-to-end lifecycle of legal operations processes (including third-party subpoena response and data subject access requests). This is a working technical leader, not a purely administrative one: you will split your time between setting technical direction, reviewing architecture and code, and unblocking your team, while also owning delivery, people management, and quality across a blended team of inshore and offshore developers. You will partner closely with product, legal operations subject-matter experts, and company leadership to translate complex legal workflow requirements into a scalable, secure, AI platform.

Responsibilities

Hands-on technical leadership

Stay directly involved in architecture, design reviews, and code review; write and troubleshoot code alongside the team when needed, especially on critical-path or high-risk work
Set and enforce engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, and documentation
Own the technical roadmap for the platform, including its evolving AI-enabled capabilities (automated workflow steps, intelligent document handling, and related legal-automation features)
Evaluate and introduce new technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML tooling that improve platform capability, reliability, or velocity

Delivery and execution

Translate business and legal-operations requirements into technical designs, epics, and sprint-level plans
Run agile ceremonies and manage delivery against roadmap commitments and client-facing milestones.
Identify and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and cross-team dependencies before they impact delivery.
Own production reliability, performance, and security posture for the platform, including multi-tenant data isolation and role-based access controls.

Cross-functional collaboration

Partner with product management, legal operations subject-matter experts, and client-facing teams to shape the platform roadmap
Report progress, risks, and technical trade-offs to executive leadership
Coordinate with external partners and vendors on integrations where relevant

Team Leadership

Directly manage a blended team of inshore and offshore software developers, engineers, and QA staff, structured for follow-the-sun or overlapping-hours delivery
Hire, onboard, mentor, and performance-manage team members across all locations, holding both onshore and offshore staff to the same engineering bar
Build and coach a team structure that pairs senior technical leadership with distributed development capacity, evolving hiring and staffing strategy as the platform and team scale
Establish clear communication norms, documentation practices, and handoff processes to keep a geographically distributed team aligned and productive
Foster a collaborative, accountable engineering culture across time zones and locations

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience

10+ years of professional software development experience, with 4+ years in a hands-on engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent)
Demonstrated experience building and leading distributed teams that combine onshore/inshore and offshore or nearshore developers
Strong, current hands-on technical ability — able to read, review, and contribute to code, not solely manage from a distance
Proven track record delivering complex, multi-tenant, web-based enterprise software from architecture through production
Experience with modern software architecture: RESTful APIs, relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), cloud infrastructure, and secure, role-based multi-tenant systems
Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum delivery practices, including sprint planning, backlog management, and release management
Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting technical strategy and status to executive stakeholders
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications & Technical Skills

Experience in legal technology, legal operations, eDiscovery, or another regulated/compliance-driven enterprise software domain
Hands-on exposure to applying AI/ML capabilities within a product (e.g., intelligent document classification, automation of manual workflow steps, LLM-based features)
Experience with workflow or business-process-configuration engines (configurable stages, tasks, and rules-driven automation)
Familiarity with SSO/identity integration, audit/compliance logging, and enterprise security requirements
Experience integrating with or migrating to project/issue-tracking systems (e.g., Jira) and CI/CD toolchains
Advanced degree (MS in Computer Science or related field) a plus
Relevant certifications (AWS, PMP, or Scrum/SAFe) a plus

Director of Programs and Engineering - X-Bow Solid Rocket Motor Division

Company Overview

X-Bow Launch Systems, Inc. (pronounced "Crossbow") is a U.S. defense technology and rocket propulsion company that has developed an innovative, low-cost method to manufacture solid rocket motors. Our propulsion technology, space launch capabilities, and modular boost platforms make us unique and highly desirable aerospace supplier to the defense and national security industries.

Position Summary

X-Bow is seeking an exceptional Director of Programs and Engineering to join our Defense Systems Sector. Reporting directly to the VP of Solid Rocket Motor Programs and Production, this senior leadership position will provide strategic direction and operational oversight for both program management and engineering functions. This role requires a dynamic leader capable of bridging technical excellence with program execution, managing multiple rocket motor development and production programs from initial customer interaction through final delivery while simultaneously leading engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions on accelerated timelines.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Provide strategic direction and leadership for integrated program management and engineering operations across the Defense Systems Sector

Support the VP of Solid Rocket Motor Programs and Production in developing and executing organizational strategy

Drive alignment between engineering capabilities and program requirements to ensure successful delivery

Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across programs and engineering teams

Program Management Leadership

Direct and oversee multiple rocket motor development and production programs simultaneously

Develop comprehensive program portfolios that outline goals, timelines, resources, and budget requirements across all programs

Ensure programs are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while maintaining technical excellence

Serve as senior escalation point for program challenges and strategic customer engagements

Lead proposal development efforts and strategic customer interactions

Engineering Leadership

Provide technical leadership and direction for SRM Engineering and SRM Mechanical Engineering teams

Ensure engineering deliverables meet rigorous design, analysis, testing, and validation requirements for solid rocket motors

Drive technical innovation in solid rocket motor design, development, and manufacturing processes

Balance engineering resources across multiple programs to optimize technical outcomes and schedule performance

Establish and maintain engineering standards, processes, and best practices

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams across Solid Large Motor Programs, Small Motor Programs, SRM Engineering, SRM Mechanical Engineering, Business Management, and Production

Manage and develop program managers and engineering leaders within the organization

Collaborate effectively with Program Scheduling, Production Scheduling, Logistics, EHS, and Quality Management functions

Build and maintain high-performing teams capable of executing on compressed timelines

Stakeholder Communication and Engagement

Serve as a senior point of contact for critical program stakeholders, including executives, government representatives, and external partners

Communicate program and engineering status, challenges, and outcomes to the VP and senior leadership

Maintain transparency and collaboration across all organizational interfaces

Represent X-Bow at customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry forums

Risk Management and Problem Solving

Identify, analyze, and mitigate strategic and technical risks across the program portfolio

Resolve complex technical and programmatic issues, applying advanced problem-solving skills

Proactively address challenges related to requirements, technical development, and manufacturing

Implement risk mitigation strategies that protect program objectives and organizational interests

Quality Assurance and Compliance

Ensure all program and engineering activities comply with organizational standards, industry regulations, and government requirements

Implement quality assurance processes to maintain the highest standards in program deliverables

Oversee rigorous design, analysis, testing, and validation of solid rocket motors

Work closely with Quality Management and EHS teams to ensure compliance and safety across all operations

Resource Management and Business Operations

Manage departmental budgets and resources effectively to meet organizational objectives

Optimize resource allocation across programs and engineering functions

Support business development activities and strategic growth initiatives

Drive operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness while maintaining technical excellence

Continuous Improvement

Evaluate program and engineering performance and identify areas for improvement

Implement best practices and lessons learned into future programs and engineering processes

Champion organizational learning and knowledge management initiatives

Contribute to the advancement of X-Bow's innovative manufacturing methodologies

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, or related field) required

Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related field strongly preferred

Experience

Minimum of 10-12 years of progressive experience in the aerospace or defense industry

Minimum of 5-7 years in leadership roles managing programs and/or engineering teams

Extensive experience in program or project management, with demonstrated success managing complex, multi-million dollar programs

Strong technical expertise in solid rocket motor design, development, and manufacturing highly desired

Proven experience in proposal development and management in the aerospace/defense sector

Experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple concurrent programs

Track record of successful customer engagement and relationship management with government and commercial clients

Skills and Competencies

Exceptional leadership and people management skills with ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams

Deep understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and tools (Agile, Waterfall, Earned Value Management)

Strong technical acumen with ability to make sound engineering and programmatic decisions

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills

Strategic thinking with ability to balance long-term vision with near-term execution

Proven ability to work independently and make decisions with minimal oversight in fast-paced environments

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under compressed timelines

Experience with government contracting, ITAR compliance, and defense industry regulations

Location Requirements

This position may be based in the vicinity of existing X-Bow offices, including:

Luling, TX

Salt Lake City, UT

Huntsville, AL

Others

jobs.title: Executive Director, ERP & Value Chain Platform Engineering

is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.

Position Summary

The Executive Director, ERP & Value Chain Platform Engineering is a senior technology executive accountable for the enterprise platforms that enable ELC's end-to-end value chain across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Procurement, Warehouse Management, and Research & Development. Reporting to the Vice President, Enterprise Platform Engineering, this role serves as the executive platform owner responsible for the strategy, governance, lifecycle management, modernization, and business outcomes of ELC's SAP-centric ERP and Value Chain platform portfolio.

Operating within ELC's Enterprise Platform Engineering operating model, this leader serves as the primary technology counterpart to Enterprise Product Design Engineering, Tech, Data & Analytics Leaders, Enterprise Architecture, Operations & Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Enterprise Business Services (EBS), and strategic technology partners. Collette is looking for a Director, Digital Analytics Architecture and Engineering
to join our growing Engineering Team. This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters in Pawtucket, RI .

About Collette: Let Us Show You the World!

There has never been a better time to be in the travel industry. See the world, connect with others, and experience the immersive benefits of one of the trendiest industries when you join the Collette team! As the longest-running tour operator in North America, our family-owned business leads the industry in innovation and expertise. Collette’s passionate team works hard to fulfill travel dreams and is always looking for talent that will help to shape the company’s future. Being part of the Collette team means having a willingness to grow, a desire to learn and ask questions, and a zest for seeing the world. From giving back to local communities to creating incredible experiences for a world of travelers and being part of a value-oriented team that cares for one another – Collette is all about the people. So, what are you waiting for? Your journey starts here.

Job Summary:

The Director, Digital Analytics Architecture and Engineering owns the strategy, architecture, governance, delivery, support, and optimization of the data layer and tagging architecture across the company’s websites, applications, user portals, and downstream marketing systems. This leader defines the blueprint for how customer and behavioral data flows from digital experiences through standardized data layers into tag management systems (TMS) and other downstream platforms. They establish the long-term technical direction and operating model for the digital analytics ecosystem, ensuring that the architecture is scalable, compliant, and capable of producing reliable, actionable data for lead intake, sales generation, and customer experience decisions. This is a new role for Collette, and this person will be responsible for standing up a new architecture for our Digital Products Systems.

This leader aligns product engineering, marketing, analytics, and operations around a shared digital analytics strategy, portfolio priorities, delivery commitments, and measurable outcomes. They establish decision-making and escalation mechanisms, communicate progress and risk to senior stakeholders, and sequence complex initiatives across multiple phases when necessary.

The Director serves as the senior technical authority for the company’s digital analytics ecosystem, including its websites, applications and user portals, data layer architecture, user-driven events, tagging standards, tag management systems (TMS), consent controls, and downstream integrations. They define architectural principles, data contracts, naming conventions, and engineering standards; guide significant technical decisions; and ensure that data moves through the ecosystem securely, consistently, reliably, and sustainably.

Primary Functions:

Define and maintain the end-to-end digital analytics architecture, documenting how customer and behavioral data flows from websites, applications, and user portals through standardized data layers into tag management systems (TMS), analytics platforms, and downstream marketing integrations.
Work with product management to create a product & technical roadmap.
Document change-management decisions and proposed roadmap changes.
Translate business and compliance needs from marketing team into clear technical requirements.
Turn complex technical requirements into quarterly projects and sequence tasks realistically to meet deadlines.
Facilitate alignment among web engineers, marketing analysts, product management and digital analytics, ensuring stakeholders are informed throughout project planning and execution.
Create comprehensive testing plans which include stakeholders’ acceptance testing phases.
Own tracking, consent and data usage requirements; ensure these are included into each project across digital platforms.
As projects bring systems online, coordinate with operations and support teams to identify run-state requirements, support models, handoff needs. Identify production risks so projects are scoped with ongoing ownership in mind.
Lead and develop a management structure that may include managers responsible for distinct areas of digital analytics engineering. Set clear accountabilities, coach leaders, assess organizational capacity, support succession planning, and evolve team structure and skills as the digital analytics portfolio grows.

Knowledge & Skills:

Demonstrated expertise in modern digital-platform architecture across websites, applications, user portals, frontend and backend services, standardized data layers, tag management systems (TMS), and third-party marketing integrations, with the ability to document current-state data flows, define scalable target-state architecture, and set technical direction.
Experience partnering with product management and senior stakeholders to create product and technical roadmaps, govern change decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and translate strategy into realistic quarterly delivery plans.
A track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives across engineering, marketing, product management, digital analytics, privacy, and operations, establishing clear requirements, decision rights, milestones, and accountability for outcomes.
Deep experience with digital analytics, event tracking, data layer design, tag management systems (TMS), consent management, customer relationship management, and marketing technology platforms, including the governance of event schemas, naming conventions, data collection, usage, quality, and compliance requirements.
Proven ability to produce clear technical, decision, and change-management documentation; define comprehensive testing and stakeholder acceptance plans; and communicate architecture, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience leading engineering or analytics organizations through managers, including setting direction, developing leaders, planning capacity, identifying delivery and production risks early, and establishing sustainable operating and support models.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in taking care of our team—inside and outside of work. The pay range for this position is $180,000 - $215,000.

Health & Wellness: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage—plus a Peloton One Membership to keep you moving

Volunteer Time: Paid hours to give back to causes you care about
Financial Security: 401(k) with company match
Family Support: Paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave and access to our Employee Assistance Program
Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement to help you level up your skills
Exclusive travel discounts, incentives and more!

Senior Engineering Manager – Checkfront & Regiondo

About The Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the teams responsible for Checkfront and Regiondo, established booking-management products used by thousands of tour, activity, and experience operators.

Checkfront and Regiondo are mature, revenue-generating products with years of functionality and customer needs represented in their codebases. The teams will continue delivering meaningful product improvements while placing increased emphasis on stability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational confidence.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will be accountable for the health, development, performance, and delivery of the engineering teams for both products. You’ll work closely with Product, senior technical contributors and other engineering leaders to establish priorities, make sound tradeoffs, and create an environment in which engineers can effectively work and grow.

We employ a player-coach model for engineering leadership. You won’t be expected to be the team’s primary implementer or sole technical decision maker, and your success will not be measured by your personal output. You will, however, be expected to remain close enough to the work to represent the major systems, architectural decisions, delivery risks, incidents, and operational characteristics across your area. You should be able to explain the technical approach for both teams, participate credibly in engineering discussions, and make high-level decisions.

This is a role for a technical leader who enjoys leading people as well as improving how engineering teams build and deliver quality software.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Develop Teams

Set clear expectations and create an environment of trust, accountability, and respectful collaboration across the Checkfront and Regiondo teams
Hold effective one-on-ones and provide timely, specific, actionable feedback
Support engineers in building meaningful growth plans and developing their careers
Recognize strong performance and address performance concerns directly
Develop senior engineers and emerging technical leaders, creating opportunities for them to take on broader responsibilities
Maintain awareness of team morale, workload, delivery constraints, interpersonal dynamics, and capacity
Participate in hiring and onboarding new team members as the teams evolve

Own Multi-Team Delivery and Operational Outcomes

Partner closely with Product to establish priorities, sequencing, and delivery plans across both products, aligning to the tech organization’s overall goals
Create alignment when teams have shared dependencies, competing priorities, or overlapping ownership
Balance new product development with reliability, maintenance, testing, technical debt, performance, and longer-term engineering health
Surface delivery risks, dependencies, ownership gaps and capacity constraints early
Establish clear ownership and hold teams accountable for delivering work to an appropriate quality standard
Remain actively engaged in production incidents and escalations, understanding their customer impact, contributing factors, and remediation
Maintain accountability for stable, secure deployments and appropriate post-deployment observability

Provide Technical and Operational Leadership

Maintain sufficient technical and operational context across Checkfront and Regiondo to understand their major systems, dependencies, risks, and incidents
Identify opportunities to make team processes and engineering practices more effective
Participate in important technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and help the team make pragmatic tradeoffs
Help the teams improve maintainability, observability, testing, reliability, and overall engineering quality
Ensure that technical investments are connected to meaningful customer, product, operational, or business outcomes
Stay hands-on enough with both team’s work and systems to understand the practical constraints the engineers are working within
Use evidence to understand whether changes to tools or working practices are actually improving team outcomes

What We’re Looking For

Experience successfully leading and developing software engineers in an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager, or comparable engineering leadership role
Experience operating across multiple engineering teams and product areas
Strong people-management skills, including coaching, feedback, career development, expectation setting, and addressing performance concerns
Experience developing senior engineers or technical leaders
A track record of creating accountability without relying on micromanagement
Strong operational instincts, including experience with production incidents, observability, reliability, and learning from recurring failures
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to communicate engineering concerns to Product, Support, leadership, and other stakeholders
An ownership mindset: when something affecting your area is going wrong, you stay engaged until there is clarity around impact, ownership, next steps, and resolution

Nice to Have

Familiarity with some of the technologies used across Checkfront and Regiondo, including PHP, React, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud Platform
Experience working closely with customer-facing teams such as Support or Customer Success
Experience with AI-assisted software-development tools and an interest in applying them pragmatically and responsibly
Experience in booking, ecommerce, travel, tours and activities, or other operationally complex domains
Experience helping teams incrementally modernize complex systems without requiring large-scale rewrites
Experience improving test coverage, deployment automation, incident response, and production observability
